targets.why_it_exists: Before the Constraint kind existed in fco, derive needed *some* recognized surface; a string marker was the cheapest stand-in. effort2 had the kinded form; the fco port dropped it (parallel-branch regression, not a deliberate cut).
targets.risk_if_fossilized: Derive stays a bespoke lowering path; Derive/Evidence semantics pinned by executor behavior not a kind law; the originating typed-metaprogramming telos becomes folklore.

targets.owner_decision_needed: No new decision — sequencing already set (K04 gated on K07). Architect signoff needed at K04a per graph note.

targets.title: Evidence / ImplBuilder / Reflect as opaque Value markers (no data)
targets.current_mechanism: provider_executor.rs Value enum carries Builder/Reflect/Evidence variants with NO payload (Value::Evidence/Reflect/Builder); seeded by capability-name match into the initial scope (provider_executor.rs:385-391). Capabilities are nominal tokens, not structured objects.
targets.final_target: K06 (evidence-bearing codomains * -> A<B>), P20 (capabilities as FCO provisions/evidence). effort2 had Evidence/ImplBuilder : Constraint -> * as real PrimTy kinds.
targets.why_it_exists: The provider interpreter only needs to thread capability *authority*, not capability *data*, to run a provider body; an opaque marker is sufficient for the current command language.
targets.risk_if_fossilized: Evidence semantics defined by the interpreter, not by the evidence schema/kind system; blocks evidence-as-data and the kinded codomain story.
open_questions: Does the evidence-bearing codomain require Value to carry data, or only the kind system to label it? (K06 design.)
targets.recommended_next_action: Leave as-is; graduates with BR0/K04. Healthy bridge.

targets.title: Provider capability authority is string-keyed + provider bodies exempt from type/borrowck
targets.current_mechanism: Capability keys are head-identifier strings REFLECT_KEY="Reflect" / IMPL_BUILDER_KEY="ImplBuilder" (provider.rs:30-31), matched at provider.rs:170-174. The minimal capability check is two presence assertions (provider.rs:176-190); no grade/key system. Provider fn bodies are exempted from ordinary type-check (ty/mod.rs:386-389 and :718-721 both filter `!is_derive_provider_fn`) and from borrowck (borrowck/check.rs:185). Grants produce NO DischargedObligation / provenance.
targets.final_target: P10 (compile-time-only invariants) -> P20 (capabilities as FCO provisions/evidence) -> P30 (retire string keys) -> K07/BR2. Hard prerequisite for K04a per FCO_K03_K04_EXECUTION_MAP.md (two recognition paths clash otherwise).
targets.why_it_exists: The provider executor is a separate compile-time interpreter; typing its bodies through the normal pipeline (which assumes runtime semantics) was deferred. String keys were the minimal recognition mechanism.
targets.risk_if_fossilized: Authority = whatever the executor accepts; a permanent type/borrowck hole for provider bodies; no evidence trail for capability grants; blocks the entire K04 graduation (which needs PrimTy-ized capabilities and one recognition path).
open_questions: What is the typed shape of a capability obligation (grade/key/scope)? NEEDS_DESIGN. Can a body be partially typed (signature only) without full provider-body typing?
targets.recommended_next_action: ARCHITECT-DECISION first (capability type design = P00/P10). This is the highest-leverage bridge-drift item: it gates K04. Add an authority/escape guard fixture as cheap interim hardening.
targets.owner_decision_needed: YES — capability typing design pass before any code (the K07 prerequisite for K04a).

targets.title: Unchecked arithmetic vs proof-backed range/resource evidence
targets.current_mechanism: #[arithmetic(unchecked)] asserts a RUNTIME non-overflow property. Const-predicate CTFE proves only COMPILE-TIME constant facts; it categorically cannot establish runtime range/resource facts.
targets.final_target: S50 (unchecked-arithmetic replacement policy) -> S60 (check elision from evidence) -> S10 (SMT backend, first non-empty premises) -> RT50 (resource proof evidence). The premises slot (BR10) is reserved precisely to make this future reachable.
targets.why_it_exists: Runtime safety facts have no compile-time discharge today; the attribute is the honest stand-in.
targets.risk_if_fossilized: Tempting but WRONG to replace it with a const predicate — that would pretend compile-time facts discharge runtime ones (unsound). The risk is doing the wrong reification.
targets.nearest_guard_fixture: the consolidation map arithmetic-unchecked caveat is the written guard; CheckPremise empty-by-design at CTFE

targets.recommended_next_action: DO NOT replace with const predicates. Track as the canonical example of a runtime fact needing premises + a proof backend.
